dedupe_keys.name: im3 open source data center atlas united states

description: The IM3 Open Source Data Center Atlas maps existing data centre facilities in the United States, with their footprints where available, as part of the Integrated Multisector Multiscale Modeling (IM3) project led by Pacific Northwest National Laboratory for the US Department of Energy. Locations are taken from OpenStreetMap and processed to add facility area in square feet and the county and state of each site. The package separates point locations, individual buildings and whole campuses into three layers; a data centre may appear in one or several layers, and campuses that straddle a county line appear once per county. An online dashboard shows the atlas together with electricity infrastructure, municipal water supply and high-speed fibre availability, and later releases add projected data centres. The first version was published in June 2025 in the MSD-LIVE repository with DOI 10.57931/2550666, and a version dated February 2026 followed. Coverage: the contiguous United States, current facilities. Format and access: GeoPackage and CSV in WGS84 from MSD-LIVE, free under the Open Database Licence (ODbL). Caveats: crowd-sourced, so incomplete where OpenStreetMap contributors have not mapped sites; campus and building areas overlap; no power capacity. Simulation uses: siting and clustering analysis, hazard exposure of facilities, and coupling data-centre load growth with power and water system models. Related records: the IM3 and EPRI load projections use these locations, and the ATLAS global map covers other countries.
